## Tax Shock in SGBs

Investors in Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGBs) have been caught off guard by a sudden tax implication. What was widely perceived as a tax-efficient gold investment now carries a different tax treatment upon redemption, affecting the net returns that investors had banked on.

## Are Indian Markets Expensive?

A frequent question among investors is whether Indian stock markets are overvalued. While traditional valuation metrics like P/E ratios appear stretched, analysts point to strong earnings growth and a supportive macro environment. Timing the market is difficult; a systematic investment approach remains a prudent strategy for long-term wealth creation.

## Union Budget 2026: What It Means for Your Salary, Savings & SIPs

The recent budget introduced key changes that impact personal finance. For salaried individuals, revisions in tax slabs and deductions alter the take-home pay calculus. Changes in savings instruments affect the tax efficiency of fixed deposits and provident funds. Additionally, mutual fund SIPs see adjustments in taxation and disclosure norms, requiring investor attention.

## Macro Brief: US-India Trade Deal

US President Trump announced a historic trade deal on Monday night. Effective tariffs on Indian goods drop from 50% to 18%, the punitive 25% tariff linked to Russian crude imports is removed, and reciprocal tariffs also fall from 25% to 18%. The agreement is expected to benefit export-oriented sectors such as textiles, pharmaceuticals, and IT services.
